test.title: Washing machine — before you call an engineer

paragraphs.text: If the drum will not turn, check that the door is fully closed and that the child lock is off. A blinking light with two beeps means the filter is blocked; clean it with the machine switched off at the wall.
Do not tip the machine on its side to reach the pump, as water left inside can enter the motor. An engineer’s visit costs £75, which is waived if the fault is covered by the two-year guarantee.

document.title: Washing machine — before you call an engineer

items.quote: A blinking light with two beeps means the filter is blocked
items.prompt: Two beeps mean the drum is broken.

explanation.en: Two beeps mean a blocked filter, not a broken drum → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Екі дыбыс — сүзгі бітелген, барабан емес → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Два сигнала — засорился фильтр, а не барабан → FALSE.

items.quote: clean it with the machine switched off at the wall
items.prompt: The machine should be unplugged before cleaning the filter.

explanation.en: “switched off at the wall” — unplugged → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «switched off at the wall» — желіден ажырату → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «switched off at the wall» — отключить от сети → TRUE.

items.quote: Do not tip the machine on its side to reach the pump
items.prompt: Tipping the machine over is recommended for reaching the pump.

explanation.en: The instruction forbids tipping the machine → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Нұсқаулық машинаны бүйіріне жатқызуға тыйым салады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Инструкция прямо запрещает класть машину набок → FALSE.

items.quote: which is waived if the fault is covered by the two-year guarantee
items.prompt: The visit is free if the fault is under guarantee.

explanation.en: “waived” — the fee is not charged → TRUE.
